Initial release of wanxiang-scroll-creation.

- Introduces a content generation engine, including topic engine system, direct narration techniques, and content generation protocols.

- Implements quality control tools with quality standards, editing techniques, and AI trace removal.
- Supports automatic generation of online fiction golden three chapters.
- Provides multiplaform adaptation (Zhihu/Qidian/Jinjiang).
- Includes AI text cleansing and trace removal functionalities.
